summary: Configure OpenRouter access, discover available models, handle provider failures safely and test requests against a local server.
description: Add the provider boundary for an OpenRouter-backed feature: optional secret configuration, model discovery, routing controls and safe upstream errors. A scriptable local HTTP server lets tests inspect real requests and exercise failures without paid credentials. The application still owns its client integration, streaming, tools and interface. Live provider calls require a key and credit limits; startup and automated tests must work without one.
seoDescription: OpenRouter configuration, model discovery, routing controls and local HTTP stubs for testing provider integration without paid requests.

projectExamples.title: Structured text helper API
projectExamples.description: Use the provider configuration and stub server while implementing a custom extraction endpoint. Add schemas, prompts and output validation in the application.

projectExamples.title: Model-aware command
projectExamples.description: Add a command that uses the discovered model list and safe provider errors. Implement its client and output behavior, or select the full chat app separately.

plain.whatItIs: Connects a TypeScript app to OpenRouter, a service giving one account access to many AI models, with settings for the key and model.
